apply_policy.rule: This manifest is advisory. No file may be moved until a later apply task validates wrappers, hook adapters, import paths, docs catalog links, and rollback.
requires_before_apply: Generate exact file move/copy/link manifest from this dry-run plan.
Run import/link impact check against every moved path.
Install compatibility wrappers for host-facing root entries.
Run full acceptance and closeout on a throwaway branch or worktree.
Keep rollback commands generated and reviewed before apply.

target_layers.purpose: Repo-owned scripts, validators, closeout runtime, Prism runtime tooling and shared policy files.
Thin host-specific entry files and hook adapters that must remain compatible with AGENTS/CLAUDE/GEMINI/Copilot imports.
Long-lived lessons, reports, research, and shared-knowledge assets. Physical migration belongs to P1-2, not this dry-run.

plans.reason: The thin CLI facade can move only after root-level bin/redcap remains as a compatibility shim.
import_impact: internal calls to compass/tools and prism/tools

plans.reason: revive-cap.sh is the one-shot revival entry users may run from the current root.
rollback_plan: Keep root revive-cap.sh authoritative until shim acceptance passes

plans.reason: closeout-cap.sh is the repo-owned closeout facade used by Layer B receipt generation.
rollback_plan: Delete copied runtime version if shim validation fails

plans.reason: Most validators assume current repo-relative compass/tools paths.
rollback_plan: Do not remove original compass/tools until every caller uses a generated path map

plans.reason: Prism evidence and dispatch checks currently use repo-relative prism/tools paths.
rollback_plan: Keep original prism/tools until Prism run-state and report checks accept runtime path

plans.reason: Some references are runtime policy, others are human architecture docs; ownership must split before move.
rollback_plan: Copy selected policy files first; keep original references as source until dictionary and validators agree

plans.reason: Codex automatically imports AGENTS.md from the current workspace root.
hook_impact: Codex has no repo-owned reply-veto hook; startup import is the key adapter
rollback_plan: Root AGENTS.md remains a thin import pointer until host import behavior is revalidated

plans.reason: Task reports are evidence assets; moving them belongs to P1-2 historical asset migration with catalog and link checks.
rollback_plan: No move in P1-1; P1-2 must generate retain/archive/move/prune manifest first

global_impact.import_paths: High. Most scripts assume repo-relative paths; apply requires a generated path map or compatibility shims.
global_impact.host_hooks: High. Root AGENTS/CLAUDE/GEMINI/Copilot entries and closeout hooks must remain stable.
global_impact.docs_catalog: Medium. Catalog can track moved docs, but task-report anchors and historical links require migration tooling.
global_impact.rollback: Apply task must be copy-first, link-second, delete-last. No destructive move is allowed in the first apply pass.
global_impact.cross_plan_dependencies: SPLIT-004 cannot apply before SPLIT-001/002/003 shims are rewired, and git hooks must be retargeted before compass/tools moves.
